_doc: The Ordeal Hall's table (docs/arch/40-m4-design.md §3.12, §10.3): the Act I roster at monster level = the hall's area level (levels 13-20 and up use the same roster on the curves until Act II's exists). Data only: nothing reads it until the hall's roster mode (M4-24) and M4-38. unitsPerWave is the budget of one wave, spent by member weight as on the overworld; every championEvery-th wave adds one champion pack. A group rolls from its minAl (the latest introAl among its members); maxAl is not used in the hall.
